title: kith-tui Cargo.toml: add reqwest, kith-core, wiremock
description:
What: Add the three missing dependencies to kith-tui so the JMAP client compiles.

Algorithm:
1. In /home/mark/WORK/KITH/Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies], add:
   reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json", "stream", "rustls-tls-manual-roots"] }
2. In /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kith-tui/Cargo.toml [dependencies], add:
   reqwest.workspace = true
   kith-core = { path = "../kith-core" }
   serde_json.workspace = true
   serde.workspace = true
3. In /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kith-tui/Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies], add:
   wiremock = "0.6"
   tokio = { workspace = true }

Defensive programming rules:
- Verify rustls-tls-manual-roots feature name is correct for reqwest 0.12 (the feature for adding custom root certs without bundled roots).
  If the feature name is wrong, the build will fail. Check ~/.cargo/registry/src/ for the reqwest 0.12 Cargo.toml if unsure.
- Do NOT add reqwest as a default-features = false dep — use the features list to control what ships.
- serde and serde_json must come from workspace so versions stay consistent.
- No version = field on kith-core (path deps don't need it).

Tests: cargo build -p kith-tui must succeed after these changes.
